column1: # Sidecar for docs/check-then-act-lock-exempt.tsv (C-GUARD-3 guard 4): who ADDED and who
# independently REVIEWED each exemption row, keyed by that file's first column. Kept separate
# so the race-fix PRs that edit the original TSV never conflict with it. Checked by
# internal/core/exemption_review_guard_test.go: every row of the original must have a row here,
# no row here may outlive its original, and reviewed_by must be non-empty and share no session/PR
# token with added_by (the root cause of #2662: the guard's author classified its own exemptions).
# A new row added to the original TSV needs a row here, reviewed by a different session.
# added_by GUARD-2 = the session that wrote the guard and first classified its 31 hits (#2609, landed via #2662).
# reviewed_by C-GUARD2-EXEMPT-REVIEW = the independent second review, #2662 (2026-10-03/04).
